title: Gregory A. Schwitzer
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the North German Mission
Married Jo Ann Elizabeth Rawsthorne 1971; five children
BA in biology, University of Utah, 1972; MD University of Utah, 1975
Assistant Professor of Internal Medicine at U of U; Physician of Emergency Medicine,Wasatch Emergency Physicians; Vice President of Clinical Support Services at Intermountain Health Care, 1992 - 2005
President of the Russia Yekaterinburg Mission
Second Quorum of the Seventy 2009 - present
